info.title: Massage booking API
info.description:
Booking API of the massage studio (modular monolith, one application). All payloads are JSON.

## Try it out runs real operations
"Try it out" sends real requests to **this server**, in the environment you opened the page from: bookings are created, profiles and schedules change, emails can be sent. Use test accounts and test data.

## Sign-in happens in Firebase, not in this API
Google, email/password and anonymous (guest) sign-in are done by the frontend with the **Firebase Authentication client SDK**. This API has no sign-in, sign-up or password routes. It only receives the resulting **Firebase ID token** in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and verifies it on every request (signature, project, expiry, revocation, disabled account).

To try protected operations: obtain an ID token from your own Firebase session in the frontend (`await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()`), click **Authorize** and paste it. ID tokens expire after about an hour. The page does not keep the token after a reload. Never paste tokens of other people.

## Who may do what
- **Public** (no token): catalogue, availability, health, the marketing subscription form and its email links. A token sent to a public route is ignored.
- **Guest**: Firebase anonymous session. Has a profile (`POST /api/me/sync`), sees and cancels own bookings, but **cannot book** (`BOOKING_NOT_READY` with `anonymous_session`).
- **Registered client**: role `client`, not anonymous. To book or reschedule, the email must be verified and the profile needs a name and a phone (`bookingReadiness.blockers` lists what is missing).
- **Gift card requests** (`POST /api/gift-card-requests`): the same profile requirements as booking (`GIFT_CARD_REQUEST_NOT_READY` with the same `blockers`); guests cannot submit.
- **Administrator**: role `admin` (assigned by the owner with a command, never through the API), not anonymous, **verified email**. Only administrators use `/api/admin`; they do not book for themselves.

Routes under `/api/me`, `/api/bookings`, `/api/gift-card-requests` and `/api/admin` exist only when Firebase is configured on the server; `/api/marketing` and `POST /api/me/marketing/subscription` only when marketing is enabled (otherwise `404 NOT_FOUND`).

## Money
Integer **euro cents**, currency `EUR` (8500 = 85,00 €).
- `priceCents` — regular price; `effectivePriceCents` — price of a booking created **now**.
- `salePriceCents` and `saleEndsAt` — only while a sale is active (server time strictly before `saleEndsAt`), otherwise both `null`. Exactly at `saleEndsAt` the regular price applies.
- The price is decided by the server at the **moment the booking is created** (not the session date) and stored in the booking (`service.priceCents` of the booking). Rescheduling, the end of a sale and catalogue changes never change it. Prices in requests are not accepted.

## Time
- Requests: instants in ISO 8601 **with an offset** (`2027-03-02T08:00:00Z` or `2027-03-02T09:00:00+01:00`). Responses: UTC (`…Z`).
- Business time zone: **Europe/Paris** (summer and winter time). Local dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, local times `HH:MM`.
- One minimum break of **15 minutes** between two sessions.
- **Grid of starts:** every 15 minutes from the start of a free stretch: the start of a working interval, or the end of the previous session plus the break. The session must fit in the working interval (the break after the last session need not).
- **Latest start 19:00** local time (inclusive).
- A new start (booking or rescheduling) must be at least **12 h** from now and not later than the end of the local day **today + 45 days**.
- **Rescheduling** by the client only while **more than 12 h** remain before the current start; the service and the agreed price stay.
- **Cancelling** (client or admin) only **before the start**.

## Idempotency-Key
Required on `POST /api/bookings` and `POST /api/gift-card-requests` (the same rules for both; below for bookings): 8–128 characters `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` (a UUID fits), one per booking attempt of the client. A repeat with the same key and the same request returns the original booking (`200`, header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) with its original price, even after a sale has ended; no second booking or event. The same key with a different request is `422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. Rescheduling and cancelling are idempotent without a key: a repeat answers `changed: false`.

## Email status
Booking emails are separate from the booking status. `accepted` means **accepted by the email provider for sending, not delivered to the mailbox**. A failed email never cancels or changes the booking.

## retryAfterSeconds
- In errors (also the `Retry-After` header, and in the message): `AUTH_UNAVAILABLE` (5 s), `CALENDAR_BUSY` (2 s), `GIFT_CARD_REQUEST_BUSY` (2 s), `GIFT_CARD_REQUEST_LIMIT_REACHED` (until the oldest of the client's requests of the last 24 h is 24 h old), `CONFIRMATION_EMAIL_NOT_SENT`: the remaining resend block of the address after a provider rate limit (until the provider's Retry-After, or 10 minutes), otherwise 60 s. A retry before that sends nothing and answers `no_action`.
- In `POST /api/me/marketing/subscription` with `outcome: "no_action"`: seconds until "send again" may send a new confirmation email (10-minute interval after a sent email; after a provider rate limit, until the provider's Retry-After).

## Errors
`{ "message": "…", "code": "…" }` plus fields of some codes (`errors`, `blockers`, `reason`, `retryAfterSeconds`, `currentConsentTextVersion`, `conflicts`). Unknown fields in request bodies are rejected (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`). Malformed JSON: `400 INVALID_JSON`; body over 16 kB: `413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`; unknown route: `404 NOT_FOUND`.

post.summary: Subscribe the signed-in user's own address (verified: at once; unverified: double opt-in)
post.description: Explicit (re-)subscription of the signed-in user's own email (from the verified Firebase token; there is no address in the body), also after unsubscribing. **Verified email** (`email_verified` in the token): active at once, `200 { outcome: "subscribed", welcomeEmail, marketing }` and a 'you are subscribed' email with an unsubscribe link; a waiting confirmation link stops working; `already_subscribed` when it was active (no email). A failed welcome email never undoes the subscription (`welcomeEmail: "not_sent"`, or `"unknown"` after a timeout). **Unverified email**: double opt-in, `202`, subscribed only after the emailed link (POST /api/marketing/subscriptions/confirm); at most one confirmation email per address per 10 minutes: inside that interval (or while a provider rate limit lasts) `no_action` with `retryAfterSeconds`; when the outcome of sending is unknown (timeout), `no_action` too. Registered users only (not guests); only when marketing is enabled.

post.summary: Ask the studio for a gift card
post.description: A request handled by hand by the studio: no online payment, no card code, no tracking of its use. Only a client ready as for booking (registered, verified email, name, phone; not an admin). Name and phone come from the profile, the email from the verified identity: the body never carries contacts (unknown fields are `400`). They are copied into the request: later profile changes do not touch it. The phone is format-checked, not verified. Currency EUR, set by the server; any whole number of cents > 0 within the stored range (no fixed values, no minimum or maximum). `description`: optional, at most 1000 characters after trimming; empty or only spaces is stored as null; no control characters except line breaks and tabs. `preferredContactChannel`: how the client wants to be contacted by hand (`whatsapp` is only a preference, there is no WhatsApp integration). Requires `Idempotency-Key` (see Idempotency-Key; one key per request the client decides to send). At most 5 new requests per client in 24 hours (replays do not count). The studio gets one email at once (no delay); `notification` shows its state, separate from `status`: a failed email never cancels the request. The client gets no email. Does not take the masseuse's time (no calendar lock).

post.summary: Close dates for new bookings and moves (existing bookings stay)
post.description: 1–62 distinct dates, all at once under the calendar lock. A closure is a layer on top of the date's schedule: no new booking or move to these dates, time freed later by a cancellation or a move stays closed. Existing bookings stay valid, are not cancelled and are listed in `bookings` so the clients can be contacted. Closing a closed date again changes nothing. Other schedule changes keep their `409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT` checks. Verified administrator only.

patch.summary: Set the status of a gift card request
patch.description: Allowed: `new` → `in_progress`, `completed` or `cancelled`; `in_progress` → `completed` or `cancelled`. `completed` (manual handling finished — not a payment confirmation or an issued card) and `cancelled` (mistaken, duplicate or withdrawn; kept in the history) are final. Setting the current status again answers `changed: false` and adds no history entry. Every change is recorded with its time and administrator. No deleting or editing of requests. Sends no email. Verified administrator only.
